packageRules.description: packages/sdk is held below TypeScript 7 by openapi-typescript. TS 7 is the native Go port (tsgo) and no longer ships the JS compiler API, so `ts.factory` is undefined and openapi-typescript crashes on import while generating src/generated/schema.d.ts. TS 6 still exposes ts.factory and works, so v6 is allowed. Lift this rule once openapi-ts/openapi-typescript#2841 ships TS 7 support; the rest of the monorepo already runs TS 7 via the workspace catalog.
